declaration.population_description: Synthetic design records supplied as the complete declared RDF-class population in each input. External legal/application eligibility and experimental edition selection are caller research assumptions, not inferred RDF facts or real-vessel certification. Records may be incomplete, inconsistent or contain unrecognized values. Conditions within the represented requirement, missing represented inputs, activation, datatype/unit/path and logical correctness remain for generated SHACL to assess. Evaluation covers finite represented inventories, not reconstruction of unrecorded real-world persons/components; this does not authorize inventing existence requirements or treating a represented missing value as compliant. Stored ice-navigation loading records and independently supplied UIWL draught and permitted ice-trim design references. Authenticity of reference limits and environmental observations is assumed for research rather than recomputing waterline geometry or performing a physical survey. Navigation state and recorded loading inputs are not assumed compliant.
